name: How does green building improve energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: How does green building improve energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Green practices optimize insulation, windows, HVAC systems, lighting, and appliances to reduce heating/cooling loads by 30-50% compared to standard construction, lowering utility bills long-term. wbdg​
